study type: Explanatory sequential mixed-method design (quantitative medical record review and qualitative in-depth interviews)
exposure: Type of Primary Health Center (BEmONC vs. non-BEmONC)
Provider adherence to integrated antenatal care (ANC) guidelines
outcome: Provider adherence to integrated ANC guidelines (overall and specific components like general physical examination, dentist visits, haemoglobin tests, urine protein tests)
cohort: The study included 149 medical records of pregnant women from four Primary Health Centers in Semarang, Indonesia, and four midwife coordinators for qualitative interviews.
finding: Provider adherence to the integrated ANC guideline was found to be low in both BEmONC and non-BEmONC PHCs, with no significant difference between the two types of centers.
